about: Adjala-Tosorontio is a township in Simcoe County, Ontario, southwest of Barrie toward the Niagara Escarpment—not a city. Hamlets such as Everett, Loretto, and Hockley-area approaches sit among farms, forest, and rolling hills on the county’s southwestern edge. About 11,000 people live in Adjala-Tosorontio.
